label: Article
description: Blog post page type: title, cover, excerpt, publication date, slice zone, SEO tab. Route /blog/:uid rendered by src/app/blog/[uid]/page.js. Pair with the Articles reference slice (examples/slices/Articles).
after: Connect the slices an article may use: npx prismic slice connect <slice_id> --to article
A /blog listing page is a regular Page document (uid "blog") with the Articles slice (variation default)
The Articles slice, variation related, goes in the article's own slice zone for "next 3 articles"
